name: QQ Mail
description: Search, read, and organize messages through QQ Mail IMAP/SMTP, and create drafts or send mail. Cindy stores the authorization code securely and provides it to the plugin Worker only while handling a mail request.
whenToUse: Use when the user needs to find, read, or organize QQ Mail messages, create a draft, or send mail. Before first use, enter the QQ Mail address and IMAP/SMTP authorization code in the plugin details and complete the connection test.

qq_mail_status.description: Check whether QQ Mail is configured. Returns only the email address and connection status, never the authorization code.

qq_mail.description: Query and manage QQ Mail via IMAP/SMTP. send/draft attachment_paths accepts explicitly authorized absolute paths on the Cindy computer: up to 10 regular files, 32 MiB total, unchanged. Worker sends via smtp.qq.com or saves via imap.qq.com. send/draft/read return attachment names, sizes and SHA-256; read does not download files. Do not use top-level dir/attachments. Sends and mutations require explicit user intent; verify mailbox state before retrying an unknown outcome. read rejects encoded messages over 48 MiB, including body and MIME; check the size returned by search first. Search returns at most 20 per page. Continue with next_page_token as page_token and identical filters until has_more=false; claim full coverage only if coverage_complete=true throughout. since/before filter received_at exactly (inclusive/exclusive); date-only means UTC+8. Headers are filtered on local metadata. Full-text server search may miss mail; text_scope=metadata searches only decoded headers without reading bodies.

qq_mail_connect.description: Connect the given QQ Mail address using the IMAP/SMTP authorization code already saved securely by Cindy. Verify imap.qq.com and smtp.qq.com, then save the email address. Use after secure credential entry to complete or restore setup. Pass only the email address, never the authorization code. Does not send email.
